rationale: T033's scoped search implementation is locally present and its recorded index, lint, typecheck, focused Vitest, and full-test checks pass. T034 stopped because search:index rewrote .generated/search/search-records.json outside its allowlist. Search evidence remains incomplete: browser specs do not exercise search, and no final search-specific browser, a11y, or build receipt exists. The broader brief also remains incomplete across design, content, ingestion, operations, and external activation.

worker_package.objective: Recover and complete the search evidence milestone by explicitly regenerating the local search artifact, adding focused browser coverage for the search page and dialog, running dedicated-port e2e/a11y/build verification, and updating launch evidence truthfully without changing search implementation or activating external services.
stop_if: Any write is needed outside allowed_files.
search:index writes any generated artifact other than .generated/search/search-records.json.
The dedicated-port browser run is not a real Paper & Slate app or cannot launch.
A browser failure requires changing search implementation or expanding the allowlist.
External credentials, provider calls, Tower, Kit, DNS, or production activation appears.
The same verification command fails twice.

evidence: T033 records passing local search/index, lint, typecheck, focused tests, and full tests.
T033 records e2e failing twice before app startup at the Windows standalone .next tree.
T034 records successful .next cleanup, then an out-of-scope search artifact write.
Existing browser smoke/a11y specs cover homepage and health, not search.
General browser/axe/Docker evidence is not search-specific; Lighthouse remains pending.
missing_evidence: Search artifact regeneration with explicit allowlist coverage.
Dedicated-port search-page and dialog browser evidence.
Remaining design-system, public-content, docs-ingestion, hardening/operations, and external activation requirements.

parallel_safety.reason: The generated search artifact, .next tree, browser tests, reports, and launch evidence share one verification boundary; run as the sole Worker.

required_board_updates: Record T035 as done with decision not_complete and full_outcome_complete false.
Create exactly one sole Worker task from worker_package.
Keep design-system, public-content, docs-ingestion, hardening/operations, and external activation separate.
Do not treat general browser or Docker receipts as search-specific acceptance evidence.
